title: browser.state
description: Host -> bridge, unsolicited. Reports panel presentation, page ownership, sharing and handover. The bridge keeps only the most recent frame.

state.description: opened: panel in full view, page alive. collapsed: page alive, panel not in full view. closed: no page.

by.description: Who caused this change. Omitted on re-reports that do not correspond to a specific action. system only for OS termination of the web content process.

owner.description: Who caused the current page to load; null when there is no page.

handed.description: true while the browser is handed over to the user.

url.description: Only on closed frames with by=system (and their verbatim re-reports).

title.description: As url; only if the page had been committed.
